title: Palazzo dei Conservatori and Caffarelli museum ranges
visualBrief: Complete connected Conservatori/Caffarelli museum building group on the standard mapped parent and eight integral parts. Seven-bay eastern piazza facade with giant stone pilasters, real recessed ground portico, paired Ionic column proxies, pedimented upper windows, deep cornice and balustrade; open mapped internal courtyard, irregular connected rear ranges, terracotta roofs and a modern curved hall roof proxy. Original simplified roof figures; no copied statues, art, text or furnished galleries.
